info.title: Playbook of Burma API
info.description: REST API for the Playbook of Burma video/podcast learning platform. All routes live under app/api/**/route.ts. See docs/API.md in the repo for prose notes.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: Signed JWT session cookie set by /api/auth/login.

bearerAuth.description: Token returned by POST /api/auth/login (native clients). Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

MembershipRequired.description: Session present but no active approved membership.

post.summary: Log in and set the session cookie

token.description: JWT bearer token for native clients.

currentPassword.description: Required unless the user still has mustChangePassword set.

post.summary: Start a password reset (emails a one-time code)
Set a new password after OTP verification
Approve a submission — provisions a User + Membership

409.description: Already reviewed, or email already in use.

post.summary: Presign one part of a multipart upload
Submit a membership application for admin review

get.summary: Get one lesson with a presigned video URL
Get the note for a lesson

put.summary: Save (or clear) the note for a lesson
